message: The certificate of laptop lapses at 2026-01-08 09:00 UTC, within a day: ssh, herdr --remote and hc from it stop then.
subject: laptop
fix: Renew it: Download bundle in its row under Settings ▸ Access ▸ Trusted machines, in the FleetLedger computer's browser or one paired from laptop (or ship-fleet trust laptop on the FleetLedger computer), then on laptop: sh install.sh from the bundle.
